name: askaroll
description: Ask your players to make rolls for you.

scripts.deploy: node --env-file-if-exists=.env -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const target=process.env.ASKAROLL_DIST_PATH; if (!target) throw new Error('ASKAROLL_DIST_PATH is required'); fs.cpSync('dist', target, { recursive: true, force: true });"
